reason: Implements GA4 historical/realtime Data API reporting and Admin API dimension, metric and stream operations with actual Google SDK clients.

tools.name: ga4_get_client_context
tools.description: Get the current GA4 client context and health status based on working directory. Call this first to confirm which GA4 property you're working with.
tools.behavior: Resolves a configured client by working directory: returns the default client in single-property mode, otherwise first folder-prefix or client-key substring match. Returns client name, property ID, folder and measurement IDs, or an error and available clients. Performs no health/API request.
notes: Description mentions health status, but handler only reads configuration.

Required string arguments reject missing/null, non-string, whitespace-only and literal undefined/null sentinel values at handler time (src/errors.ts:41-56); numeric property ID format is not validated.

tools.name: ga4_run_report
tools.description: Query GA4 historical report. Common patterns: top pages (dimensions="pagePath", metrics="screenPageViews"), traffic sources (dimensions="sessionSource,sessionMedium", metrics="sessions,totalUsers"), daily trend (dimensions="date", metrics="sessions").

order_by.description: Optional metric to sort by descending (e.g., "eventCount")

tools.behavior: Builds Data API runReport request for properties/{property_id}; splits comma-separated dimensions/metrics, defaults to eventName/eventCount and 7daysAgo/today, applies optional dimension equality filter and descending metric order. Defaults limit to 100 and caps it at 10000. Returns flattened string-valued rows, returned row_count and date_range; future start date yields empty rows with error.
notes: Defaults and limit cap are implemented in handler rather than JSON Schema; limit has no minimum/integer constraint. Filters lacking == are silently ignored; supplied filter splits only the first two segments and does not explicitly set stringFilter.matchType. Start-date future check is lexical and skips strings containing daysAgo/yesterday/today.

Required string arguments reject missing/null, non-string, whitespace-only and literal undefined/null sentinel values at handler time (src/errors.ts:41-56); numeric property ID format is not validated.

tools.name: ga4_realtime_report
tools.behavior: Builds Data API runRealtimeReport for properties/{property_id}, splitting comma-separated dimensions/metrics (defaults eventName/eventCount) and optional dimension equality filter. Returns flattened string-valued rows and returned row_count.
notes: Filters lacking == are silently ignored; supplied filter splits only first two segments and does not explicitly set stringFilter.matchType.

Required string arguments reject missing/null, non-string, whitespace-only and literal undefined/null sentinel values at handler time (src/errors.ts:41-56); numeric property ID format is not validated.

tools.name: ga4_list_custom_dimensions
tools.description: List all registered custom dimensions for a GA4 property.
tools.behavior: Calls Admin API listCustomDimensions with property parent, maps displayName, parameterName, scope and description to custom_dimensions plus count.
notes: Required string arguments reject missing/null, non-string, whitespace-only and literal undefined/null sentinel values at handler time (src/errors.ts:41-56); numeric property ID format is not validated.

tools.name: ga4_create_custom_dimension
tools.description: Register a new custom dimension in a GA4 property.
tools.behavior: Calls Admin API createCustomDimension with property parent and supplied parameter/display names; maps case-insensitive USER to USER, every other scope to EVENT, and missing description to empty string. Returns created display name, parameter_name and scope.
notes: Conditionally advertised and callable only with GA4_MCP_WRITE=true; write gate is delegated to mcp-write-gate. Scope is unrestricted string in schema, with implementation coercion to EVENT except USER.

Required string arguments reject missing/null, non-string, whitespace-only and literal undefined/null sentinel values at handler time (src/errors.ts:41-56); numeric property ID format is not validated.

tools.name: ga4_list_custom_metrics
tools.description: List all registered custom metrics for a GA4 property.
tools.behavior: Calls Admin API listCustomMetrics with property parent and returns display names, parameter names, scopes, measurement units and descriptions plus count.
notes: Required string arguments reject missing/null, non-string, whitespace-only and literal undefined/null sentinel values at handler time (src/errors.ts:41-56); numeric property ID format is not validated.

tools.name: ga4_list_data_streams
tools.description: List all data streams for a GA4 property.
tools.behavior: Calls Admin API listDataStreams with property parent and returns display name/type; web streams also include measurement_id and default_uri, plus count.
notes: Required string arguments reject missing/null, non-string, whitespace-only and literal undefined/null sentinel values at handler time (src/errors.ts:41-56); numeric property ID format is not validated.

tools.name: ga4_send_feedback
tools.description: Send feedback about the GA4 MCP tools. Use when a query didn't work as expected.

message.description: Description of the issue, request, or question

query_context.description: Optional context about what was queried

tools.behavior: Validates feedback type against bug/feature/question; appends type, message, optional query_context and ISO timestamp as JSONL to ~/.config/mcp-ga4/feedback/feedback.jsonl. Returns recorded status; invalid feedback type returns error object. Does not send feedback remotely.
notes: feedback_type choices are enforced by handler, but schema has no enum. Local logging remains enabled with remote writes disabled.

Required string arguments reject missing/null, non-string, whitespace-only and literal undefined/null sentinel values at handler time (src/errors.ts:41-56); numeric property ID format is not validated.

tools.name: ga4_suggest_improvement
tools.description: Log a GA4 query pattern that didn't work well, so it can be improved.

failed_query.description: The natural language question the user asked

expected_result.description: What the user expected to see

tools.behavior: Appends improvement type, failed_query, expected_result, optional actual_result and ISO timestamp as JSONL to ~/.config/mcp-ga4/feedback/improvements.jsonl and returns recorded status/message.
notes: Local logging remains enabled with remote writes disabled.

Required string arguments reject missing/null, non-string, whitespace-only and literal undefined/null sentinel values at handler time (src/errors.ts:41-56); numeric property ID format is not validated.
Source review only; no tools/list, upstream execution or live requests. Git HEAD matches supplied revision.
Nine total tools: eight advertised by default; ga4_create_custom_dimension additionally appears when GA4_MCP_WRITE=true. CLI auth/setup commands are not MCP tools.

Startup requires GA4_PROPERTY_ID or config.json and valid configuration of service-account keyfile or user OAuth trio; missing config/auth prevents startup (src/index.ts:106-161,186-193; src/oauthClient.ts). Startup attempts listDataStreams unless MCP_GA4_SKIP_STARTUP_CHECK is set, warning and continuing on failed API health check.

All results use safeResponse: arrays in responses above 200000 bytes are recursively shortened with truncated=true; row_count updated for shortened rows (src/resilience.ts:32-85). Google API methods use 30-second aggressive timeout, retries and per-operation circuit breakers (src/resilience.ts:87-127).

review.method: Independently compared all nine literal tool schemas and full descriptions exactly; read dispatcher, report defaults/filters, write gate, custom-definition API calls and local feedback logging. Count includes the disabled-by-default creation tool.
